name: DS Cluster S39: Downsample Sparse Series
description: Tests: ffill before downsample on sparse where()-filtered data. Without ffill, monthly buckets are mostly NaN.
source:
# =============================================================================
# DS CLUSTER S39: Downsample Sparse Series
# =============================================================================

src = study_assets()
close = src.c
rets = returns(close)

# === SPARSE SERIES: only positive return days ===
up_days = rets > 0
up_rets = where(up_days, rets)

# === WRONG: downsample sparse → mostly NaN months ===
# sparse_monthly = resample(up_rets, target_timeframe=1M, agg=["Max"])

# === CORRECT: ffill first, then downsample ===
filled_up = ffill(up_rets)
filled_monthly = resample(filled_up, target_timeframe=1M, agg=["Last"])

# === ALSO CORRECT: sum daily returns directly (no sparsity issue with sum) ===
monthly_sum = resample(up_rets, target_timeframe=1M, agg=["Sum"])

# === REPORTERS ===
histogram(
    title="Monthly Up Returns (ffill'd last)",
    category="Sparse",
    bins=20
)(filled_monthly)

histogram(
    title="Monthly Up Returns (sum, handles sparse)",
    category="Sparse",
    bins=20
)(monthly_sum)
